notes.title: Night Project – Chapter 5 IS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Dear players, we proudly present the fifth and final chapter of Night Project! This long-awaited finale will be the culmination of the entire story where all plot threads come together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/5c03ac816522b1af46eff0836c3b4a376a36d0b5.png[/img]

Key features of the chapter:

⚔ Final battle with Kili

The most complex and multi-phase combat in the game

Kili uses all known tactics plus several new ones

Requires application of all previously acquired skills

🔎 Complete plot revelations

The true nature of Degeons Intertaiment experiments

The fate of missing employees and Adrian

Kili's origins and his connection to the protagonist

🏃 Extreme parkour sections

Enhanced movement system

Deadly jumps through destroyed areas

New types of obstacles and traps

Technical improvements:

Added DLSS 3.0 support for maximum smoothness

Completely reworked movement physics

Optimized save system operation

Fixed all critical bugs from previous chapters

Story features:

3 unique endings depending on your choices

Alternative scenes for replay value

Additional documents and recordings revealing story details

"This chapter was a real challenge for our team," says the lead writer. "We tried to make a finale worthy of the whole story, keeping the tension until the last minute."

[previewyoutube=5fDJ0nqHsxY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project – Chapter 4 IS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Friends, we proudly present the fourth chapter of Night Project – the most psychologically intense part of our story!

What awaits you in the new chapter:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/60936fa8947de0c33abc5c1cf9d4ef7cbcf5c09a.png[/img]

🔹 A living, breathing office
The space literally distorts as you progress. Familiar hallways lead to the unknown, and the walls sometimes... wink. These aren’t glitches – this is your new reality.

🔹 Double threat
Kili has evolved – now there are two of them. The original has become more calculating, while the clone is utterly unpredictable. Their hunting tactics are synchronized – be careful!

🔹 The fate of the missing
Through a series of interactive simulations, you’ll uncover what happened to your colleagues from the first chapter. Each discovery is a new piece of the nightmare’s puzzle.

🔹 Arcade machines for a breather
We’ve added classic ‘90s-style arcade machines for a brief escape from the horrors. But don’t relax too much – Kili never sleeps!

🔹 Enhanced psychological atmosphere
Completely revamped lighting and sound system. Now, every step you take echoes through the office’s twisted space.

"This chapter isn’t just a continuation – it’s a whole new experience," says the lead developer. "We’ve created a world that literally resists your progress."

[previewyoutube=-H42a8c6_Wo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project - Chapter 2 RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Night Project Chapter 2 is here!

It’s time to step into a new nightmare! The second chapter of Night Project brings more terrifying challenges and deeper mysteries. This time, your superiors have sent you to the Degeons Intertainment warehouse – but why? They aren’t telling you everything. You’ll have to uncover the truth yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/1c22eeaf10b2ed4d561e4c3d0523423c979245f2.png[/img]
What’s new in this chapter?
	•	New flashlight mechanics – proper use of light is crucial for survival.
	•	New fears and eerie encounters – something is lurking in the warehouse’s shadows.
	•	Notes and tapes – find pieces of the story that reveal Degeons Intertainment’s true nature.
	•	Warehouse exploration – locked rooms, hidden corridors, and unexpected surprises.
	•	Bug fixes for Chapter 1 – improved atmosphere, optimized gameplay, and fixes based on player feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/0a3fc09c406f91a71de6a90825dbdfdb41dd5b60.png[/img]

Your superiors claim this is just a routine task… but what if the truth is far more horrifying than you ever imagined?
[previewyoutube=Ny3I017UJBE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project - New Year's Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players! We are pleased to present you a New Year's update full of festive surprises and improvements!
 • New Year decorations: The office now has bright garlands, a decorated Christmas tree and other elements that create a festive atmosphere.
 • Festive sounds: Melodious New Year sounds are waiting for you, which will definitely cheer up and create a cozy atmosphere in the game.
 • Santa Claus Quest: Complete a small quest and get a unique achievement, starting the new year with a victory!
 • Fixes and bugfixes: We have improved the sound and fixed various bugs for a comfortable game.

Happy New Year! May this holiday season be full of joy, and our game will be a source of inspiration and good mood.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/73f5214076a97f9d2a817184b4cc1771093a432c.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! I am the ghost of Halloween, and I welcome you to the Degeons office. It's especially creepy here today, because everything is decorated for this ominous holiday. But there is also something new: a strange man is waiting for you with a task.

You already know that our office is not only a place of work, but also a real maze full of dangers. And today you have to face one of them — a terrible monster that hides somewhere in dark corners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/985d4e1eb50dd925ed62e94755ae6b37276a9e0a.jpg[/img]
So get ready for an adventure, because something unusual is waiting for you! In the meantime, you can enjoy the Halloween atmosphere that reigns in our office.

What has changed in the office? Here are just some of the innovations:

Atmospheric sounds. Now you can hear ominous rustles, screams and other unusual sounds that create a special Halloween atmosphere.

Halloween decorations. The office is decorated with pumpkins, skeletons, spiders and other attributes of this holiday.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/5fd5dc152c2607e281e86380f525428deddbf445.jpg[/img]
A quest with a monster. You have to go through the maze of the office and fight a terrible monster that hides in dark corners.

Don't miss your chance to test yourself and get new experiences! But be careful, because danger can be waiting for you around every corner.

Good luck, players!

notes.title: Demo 1.5: Hotfix, gamepad support and Chinese Language!!
notes.notes:
List of corrections:

-Now when talking and listening to tapes, the player will not be able to move from a place.
-Many physical objects have collided.
-If you fall out of the game zone, the player will go back.
-The player can no longer go through a collision to quickly pass the game
-The light now has a large area of lighting.
-Kiki no longer gets stuck between static objects.
-Kili won't see you everywhere anymore.
New:
-Gamepad support
-Chinese language!!!
-Quick settings for non-experienced users.
-Control training for the gamepad
-More physical models
